correctness.rationale: For any independent dominating set, originals must be a clique; all and only subdivision vertices of edges disjoint from it are forced. Omitted originals have no selected neighbor precisely when their open neighborhood equals the chosen clique. The counting exponent follows exact degree inclusion-exclusion. Independently built central graphs and brute-forced every independent dominating set of 1043 labeled graphs with complete agreement.
